correctness.rationale: Direct symbolic differentiation of the source's engineered second-order phase field gives the stated synchrony and splay stability exponents. Expansion yields the 3/8 leading stability-matching coefficient, while exact elimination gives the finite-coupling simultaneous-marginality formulas; symbolic residuals vanish identically.

originality.rationale: Qualified to the best of our knowledge. The source derives the engineered harmonics and chooses 1/4 by harmonic cancellation but does not state the stability-targeted 3/8 coefficient, the one-knob boundary-restoration obstruction, or the exact balanced strength. Related prior literature covers higher-order phase reduction and synchrony/splay stability generally, not this source-specific design result.

value.rationale: The result analytically separates harmonic-cancellation and stability-matching design objectives, quantifies the residual synchrony-splay overlap under the source choice, and supplies both an asymptotic and exact one-parameter design rule for the reduced model.
